data.text: Disburse funds against approved invoices and collect repayments across currencies, with every transaction auto-mapped to the underlying invoice for real-time visibility and full auditability.
Enable anchor corporates to extend early payment to suppliers globally, with automated eligibility checks, staged disbursements, and multi-currency settlement across international supply chains.
Support importers and exporters with collections, FX conversion, and payouts across trading corridors, replacing slow correspondent banking with API-first rails for faster capital movement.
Facilitate buyer-seller transactions on digital trade platforms with escrow-style holds, milestone-based fund releases, and marketplace fee deduction built into a single configurable workflow.
Handle high-value, high-frequency B2B trade payments with local collection accounts, FX transparency, and straight-through reconciliation mapped to every invoice and counterparty.
Modernise legacy LC, bank guarantee, and documentary collection workflows with API-based collections, payouts, and compliance-ready audit trails that integrate into existing core banking systems.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: How does Decentro support cross-border trade finance payments?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: With multi-currency virtual accounts, escrow-style workflows, automated settlements, and FX capabilities across 170+ countries, Decentro enables seamless end-to-end trade finance payment flows for importers, exporters, and financial institutions globally.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: Can I automate supplier payouts and credit-period settlements in trade finance?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: Yes. Payment triggers can be tied to purchase orders, invoices, bills of lading, shipment events, or net terms—fully automated to reduce manual intervention and accelerate working capital cycles for all trade counterparties.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: How reliable is the system for high-value trade finance transactions?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: Decentro's multi-bank architecture ensures maximum uptime, lower settlement failures, and smooth global operations across markets—critical for high-value letters of credit, documentary collections, and supply chain finance disbursements.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.query: What is the integration timeline for trade finance payment infrastructure?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.solution: Most trade finance platforms and financial institutions go live within weeks using Decentro's robust APIs, pre-built UI modules, and flexible configuration options tailored to complex trade payment workflows.
